summary: A small dialog asking to delete an item, with Cancel and Delete buttons in the actions snippet.
use: Confirming a destructive action when you need custom footer buttons instead of the AlertDialog defaults.
spec: `description=` text says the action cannot be undone
`{#snippet actions()}` holds `<Button variant="ghost"` Cancel and `<Button variant="destructive"` Delete
Delete runs `confirmed = true; open = false;` and shows `Item deleted.` with `aria-live="polite"`
Trigger is `<Button variant="destructive"` with a `<Trash2 size={14} />` icon in `{#snippet leading()}`
